adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no topic exists it enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`, which hardcodes a `setTimeout(document.location.reload, 30000)`. This retry mechanism is indeed split across controller/job/view with no explicit shared contract (e.g., backoff, max retries, failure signaling), and the 30s interval is not configurable or documented in the diff. However, the claim that a job taking >30s causes “Loading forever” is not strictly verifiable: the page will keep reloading until the job completes, so it’s indefinite only if the job never succeeds.
